finding: config read with no validation, no default, and a swallowed KeyError
rationale: F3.4 makes error-handling the primary owner of config management; F3.3 has architecture defer config findings to it. A naive reviewer files this under architecture because the defect sits at a module boundary, which is exactly the confusion the deconfliction exists to settle.
construct: try/except KeyError whose handler body is only `pass`
